composers_checked.name: Holmboe, Vagn
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. All 21 numbered quartets are on Dacapo (Kontra Quartet cycle 1993-2001, re-issued 2010; Nightingale Quartet re-recording in progress), plus Sværm Op. 190b and nine recorded chamber works with strings (the recorder trio Op. 133 came from an Apple search); the other works with strings found no recording.

composers_checked.name: Saariaho, Kaija
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Twelve recorded works for 3-9 players with strings kept (two string-quartet works, six trios, a piano trio and the ensemble works Aer, Terrestre and Lichtbogen). None of the three violin-catalogue entries is in scope (two are violin duos, Graal théâtre needs about 17 players).

composers_checked.name: Nørgård, Per
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. All ten string quartets are recorded (Kontra Quartet 1988 for Nos. 1-6, Kroger Quartet 2008 for Nos. 7-10) plus the three clarinet trios (LINensemble 1995). The wider chamber catalogue (Dacapo, Edition Wilhelm Hansen) was checked only through Deezer and MusicBrainz, so further recorded works may be missing.

composers_checked.name: Abrahamsen, Hans
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. The four string quartets, Schnee, Six Pieces and Winternacht are recorded. Only Wikipedia, Dacapo discs on Deezer and MusicBrainz were used for the work list; the Edition Wilhelm Hansen catalogue was not opened.

composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Six recorded chamber works with strings kept; the work list comes from Deezer and MusicBrainz plus two web searches, because the Wikipedia article has no work list and the publisher's catalogue was not opened.

composers_checked.name: Pettersson, Allan

composers_checked.name: Hillborg, Anders
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Only the Kongsgaard Variations were found recorded in the string-quartet version; the English Wikipedia lists a quartet 'Heisenbergminiatyrer' (2006-07) that may be the same work, which I could not settle.

composers_checked.name: Thorvaldsdottir, Anna
composers_checked.note: No IMSLP pages. Enigma, Spectra and Ró are recorded (Spectra and Ró found through Apple; their scorings come from the Wikipedia list). Her own site could not be read (it answered with the domain name only).

note: EVIDENCE: the slice has no IMSLP candidates (all 15 composers are modern), so every entry is a gap-check addition. Work lists come from the Wikipedia lists (en; da and sv for Abrahamsen, Hillborg, Pettersson) and from the discs found through Deezer (album pages with labels and timings), MusicBrainz (work to recording to release lookups, with catalogue numbers), Apple composerTerm searches and eight web searches (scorings of Ruders's Serenade, Abrahamsen's Nocturnes, Rautavaara's quintet, Lindberg's Duo concertante, Holmboe's chamber discs). Publisher catalogues (Wise Music, Fennica Gehrman, Edition S) and the composers' own sites could not be read, so floor.published is empty throughout; Anna Thorvaldsdottir's site answered with nothing. VIOLIN CATALOGUE: none of the eight entries is cross-listed. 417 (Aho), 479 (Holmboe, Sværm Op. 190a), 513 (Pettersson), 533 and 4823 (Saariaho) are for two violins, 4206 (Aho, ER-OS) is a violin-clarinet duo, 4827 (Saariaho, Graal théâtre for violin and ensemble) needs about 17 players. 478 (Holmboe, Isomeric, 2 violins and piano) is in scope by scoring, but no recording or performance was found, so it is skipped; the string-quartet version Sværm Op. 190b is kept without violin_id. OWNER MAY RULE: (1) Pettersson's Concerto No. 1 for violin and string quartet is listed as a solo showpiece with quartet accompaniment (formation other, soloist counted as a third violin). (2) Holmboe's String Quartet No. 21 was left unfinished in 1996 and completed by Per Nørgård; kept as recorded. (3) Low-confidence entries: Rautavaara's Eingang (soprano and string quartet), Lindberg's Duo concertante (scoring from a Music Finland page seen in a search), Thorvaldsdottir's Ró (scoring from Wikipedia, recording seen in an Apple search), Nordgren's Equivocations (kantele listed as harp). (4) Electronics count as no player (Saariaho's Nymphéa, Aer, Lichtbogen; Nørgård's Quartet No. 4 with tape). (5) Saariaho's Neiges is recorded only for 12 cellos, so the 8-cello version is skipped. (6) Arrangements by an unnamed arranger are skipped: Nørgård's Spell for piano trio and Abrahamsen's Traumlieder (the Six Pieces for piano trio). OPEN PROBLEMS: Holmboe's Quartet No. 3 is Op. 48 on MusicBrainz and the Nightingale discs but Op. 49 on the Kontra set (Op. 48 used). Sallinen's Quartet No. 1 is Op. 2 in the Wikipedia list but Op. 14 on the Ondine track list, so its title has no opus. The durations of Lindberg's Clarinet Quintet, Nordgren's Quartet No. 3 (taken from Apple) and Rautavaara's Eingang are weak or missing. Recorded but not kept because the scoring could not be confirmed: Thorvaldsdottir's In the Light of Air and Illumine, Salonen's Mania, Ruders's Nightshade pieces, Nørgård's Cao Shu and Babette's Feast suite. Works with no recording found (checked on Deezer, MusicBrainz and Apple only, so 'none found' is weak for the little-known ones): Holmboe's Isomeric and Tropos, Rautavaara's Quartet No. 3, Aho's Quartets 4 and 5 and his string quintets, Nordgren's Quartets 1, 2 and 6-9, Ruders's Quartet No. 4, Lindberg's Quintetto dell'estate and UR. Levels are estimates against the Nielsen, Rosenberg and Langgaard quartets in other slices.
